quizQuestionWithSolutionDTO.title: Practice 13: binary search
quizQuestionWithSolutionDTO.text: What is the worst-case complexity of **binary search** on sorted input?
quizQuestionWithSolutionDTO.explanation: Each comparison halves the remaining interval, giving logarithmic growth.

answerOptions.explanation: The search interval is halved each step.
A linear scan checks every item.
